description: Stability AI's sound effects (Small-SFX) and music beds (Small-Music), stereo 44.1 kHz. The Small models are fast and also run on the CPU. The models are gated: accept their terms on Hugging Face and put your access token in Settings.
cpuNote: The Small models are made to run without a GPU; Medium needs a GPU.
